programs.title: House of the Dragon 2
programs.desc: The second series of the production, the events of which precede the action of "Game of Thrones".After the death of Lucerys Velaryon, the son of Queen Rhaenyra Targaryen (Emma D'Arcy), which was caused by his cousin, Aemond Targaryen (Ewan Mitchell), Westeros finds itself on the brink of a bloody civil war.The Green Council supporting King Aegon (Tom Glynn-Carney) and Queen Rhaenyra's Black Council are fighting for influence.Each side claims the Iron Throne.The dynamic development of events also affects the attitude of Rhaenyra's husband, Daemon (Matt Smith), in life.A man who spends a lot of time in Harrenhal Castle, away from his wife, changes a lot.In addition, the demons of his past begin to haunt him.

actor: King Aegon II Targaryen - Tom Glynn-Carney
Lord Corlys 'The Sea Snake' Velaryon - Steve Toussaint

programs.title: Bastarden
programs.desc: Year 1755, Denmark.The impoverished Captain Ludvig (Mads Mikkelsen) asks the king for permission to establish a colony on his behalf on the barren moors famous for their infertility.If successful, he expects to be awarded a knighthood and property.The aristocrats are outraged by his arrogance and assume defeat, but he receives consent.From then on, every day for Ludvig and his relatives is spent on hard, physical work beyond their strength, which will allow them to prepare the land for cultivation.They also hire people to help them - two runaway servants: Ann Barbara (Amanda Collin) and her husband.Months pass and the first buildings are built when the ruthless Frederik de Schinkel (Simon Bennebjerg), the land lord, tries to take over the moors.When Ludvig rejects his offer, he decides to destroy it.

programs.title: Joe Baby
programs.desc: A debt collector is to recover USD 10 million for a real estate entrepreneur.He becomes entangled in the world of crime and corruption.

programs.title: I.S.S
programs.desc: There are American and Russian astronauts on the International Space Station.The US team consists of Dr. Kira Foster (Ariana DeBose), who recently joined the team, officer Christian Campbell (John Gallagher Jr.) and the mission commander Gordon Barrett (Chris Messina).On a daily basis, they cooperate with the second group, which includes Weronika Vetrow (Masha Mashkova), Nikolaj Pulov (Costa Ronin) and his brother Alexei (Pilou Asbaek).Despite political and cultural differences, the astronauts get along great.There is a friendly atmosphere at the station, and Gordon and Weronika, who have started an affair, have something more in common.Everything changes when the six of them notice a terrifying phenomenon on Earth.Everyone watches with growing horror as a wave of fire spreads on the surface of the planet, where their homes and loved ones are located.This can only mean one thing - the outbreak of nuclear war.The situation escalates when Barrett learns that Russia has attacked the United States and receives an order from the US government to take control of the station.Together with Christian and Kira, they suspect that their colleagues received a similar task.Additionally, they discover that the station is currently orbiting too low.It will fall to Earth if help does not arrive within 24 hours.A fight for survival begins, and the former friends now turn on each other.

programs.title: Silver Star
programs.desc: African American Billie (Troy Leigh-Anne Johnson) is twenty years old and a tomboy.He comes from a military family and is missing one eye.After serving her prison sentence, she discovers that her separated parents are facing eviction.He decides to prevent this at all costs.The woman decides to rob a bank, but the action ends in failure.As a result, the young criminal takes her client hostage.Pregnant Franny (Grace Van Dien) is eighteen years old and has a head open to crazy ideas.Together they escape and set off on an adventurous journey.At one point, Franny offers Billie an unexpected deal.

programs.title: Green Book
programs.desc: USA, 1960s. Tony Vallelonga, a simple resident of the Bronx who has a wife and a group of children to support, agrees to accompany, as a chauffeur and bodyguard, a black musician - the luxurious erudite Donald Shirley - on a concert tour across the United States.Not only does he have to defend his protégé from troubles in the Deep South, but he also has to combat prejudiced views.During their journey, they both follow the instructions from the "Green Book" guidebook for African Americans traveling around the country.It includes, among others:suggestions on where to sleep and eat to avoid unpleasant incidents.The time spent together and overcoming mounting problems cause a surprising, lasting bond to emerge between men from different worlds.

actor: George Dyer - the Cellist - Mike Hatton
Copa Coat Check Girl - Maggie Nixon

programs.title: The Housewives of the North Pole
programs.desc: Friends Trish and Diana (Betsy Brandt) win the competition for the best Christmas home decoration every year.When they break off the relationship after a quarrel, they take part in the struggle as rivals.

programs.title: How to Train Your Dragon: The Hidden World
programs.desc: A grave danger looms over Berk.The unexpected appearance of a wild and elusive dragon coincides with the darkest period in the history of the settlement.Toothless loses his head for a beautiful creature.However, he does not realize that it hides a dangerous secret.She is followed by someone who intends to trap all the dragons.The enemy threatens the inhabitants of a land where flying creatures and people live in harmony with each other.The young Viking Hiccup and his friend set off on an adventurous journey.Daredevils search for the hidden world of legends.During the expedition, two different races unite to fight for what is most precious to them.The last part of the film trilogy based on the books by Cressida Cowell.In the Polish language version, the characters were voiced by, among others:Grzegorz Drojewski, Julia Kamińska, Wojciech Machnicki, Sebastian Cybulski and Tomasz Traczyński.

programs.title: Mountainhead
programs.desc: While a massive financial crisis is brewing around the world, billionaire Souper (Jason Schwartzman) invites three friends as rich as him - Randall (Steve Carell), Venis (Cory Michael Smith) and Jeff (Ramy Youssef) - to his spacious villa in the mountains.Their combined fortunes are worth $371 billion, but their guilt for the situation is zero.The men spend their time carefree, drinking alcohol and joking, as well as ironically commenting on suspicious scenes of street riots on TV or on the Internet.The feature-length directorial debut of Jesse Armstrong, the creator of "Succession" and seven-time Emmy winner.

programs.title: Avenue of the Giants
programs.desc: California.For years, 74-year-old Herbert Heller hid from his family his traumatic experiences during World War II and his stay in the Auschwitz-Birkenau camp, where he was sent at the age of twelve, and three years later he attempted to escape.All this changes when he meets Abbey (Fisher), rejected by his peers, whose own difficult experiences prompt him to open up.A moving, healing friendship develops between a man and a teenager.The story is based on the true memories of Herbert Heller, a former concentration camp prisoner who settled in the USA after the war.

programs.title: A Royal Christmas Holiday
programs.desc: A reporter interviews the prince.They fall in love with each other at first sight.

programs.title: Soul On Fire
programs.desc: Nine-year-old John O'Leary suffers burns to almost his entire body.He struggles with pain and limitations.However, he wins love and makes his dreams come true.He inspires others by showing how to live life to the fullest.
